channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2011-3402 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft Windows Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability in the TrueType font parsing engine in win32k.sys in the kernel-mode drivers that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted font data in a Word document or web page.

item.title: CVE-2021-21311 — Adminer Adminer
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Adminer contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that, when exploited, allows a remote attacker to obtain potentially sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2025-20362 — Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security (ASA) Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software VPN Web Server contain a missing authorization vulnerability. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-20333.

item.title: CVE-2025-20333 — Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security (ASA) Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software VPN Web Server contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-20362.

item.title: CVE-2024-12987 — DrayTek Vigor Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 74. DrayTek Vigor2960, Vigor300B, and Vigor3900 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability due to an unknown function of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/apmcfgupload of the component web management interface.

item.title: CVE-2017-12637 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 74. SAP NetWeaver Application Server (AS) Java contains a directory traversal vulnerability in scheduler/ui/js/ffffffffbca41eb4/UIUtilJavaScriptJS that allows a remote attacker to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the query string.

item.title: CVE-2025-1316 — Edimax IC-7100 IP Camera
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Edimax IC-7100 IP camera contains an OS command injection vulnerability due to improper input sanitization that allows an attacker to achieve remote code execution via specially crafted requests. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2022-43769 — Hitachi Vantara Pentaho Business Analytics (BA) Server
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Hitachi Vantara Pentaho BA Server contains a special element injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to inject Spring templates into properties files, allowing for arbitrary command execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-41277 — Metabase Metabase
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Metabase contains a local file inclusion vulnerability in the custom map support in the API to read GeoJSON formatted data.

item.title: CVE-2024-38094 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-40766 — SonicWall SonicOS
item.description: Threat Signal 74. SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper access control vulnerability that could lead to unauthorized resource access and, under certain conditions, may cause the firewall to crash.

item.title: CVE-2021-20124 — DrayTek VigorConnect
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the file download functionality of the WebServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2012-4792 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted web site that triggers access to an object that (1) was not properly allocated or (2) is deleted, as demonstrated by a CDwnBindInfo object.

item.title: CVE-2017-3506 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Oracle WebLogic Server, a product within the Fusion Middleware suite, contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via a specially crafted HTTP request that includes a malicious XML document.

item.title: CVE-2021-44026 — Roundcube Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Roundcube Webmail is vulnerable to SQL injection via search or search_params.

item.title: CVE-2023-22952 — SugarCRM Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Multiple SugarCRM products contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the EmailTemplates. Using a specially crafted request, custom PHP code can be injected through the EmailTemplates.

item.title: CVE-2010-2568 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft Windows incorrectly parses shortcuts in such a way that malicious code may be executed when the operating system displays the icon of a malicious shortcut file. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could execute code as the logged-on user.

item.title: CVE-2017-5521 — NETGEAR Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Multiple NETGEAR devices are prone to admin password disclosure via simple crafted requests to the web management server.

item.title: CVE-2016-2386 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 74. SQL injection vulnerability in the UDDI server in SAP NetWeaver J2EE Engine 7.40 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via unspecified vectors.

item.title: CVE-2012-0754 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2012-0151 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 74. The Authenticode Signature Verification function in Microsoft Windows (WinVerifyTrust) does not properly validate the digest of a signed portable executable (PE) file, which allows user-assisted remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-7841 — Schneider Electric U.motion Builder
item.description: Threat Signal 74. A SQL Injection vulnerability exists in U.motion Builder software which could cause unwanted code execution when an improper set of characters is entered.

item.title: CVE-2016-7201 — Microsoft Edge
item.description: Threat Signal 74. The Chakra JavaScript scripting engine in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2022-21999 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2020-5410 — VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Configuration (Config) Server
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Spring, by VMware Tanzu, Cloud Config contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows applications to serve arbitrary configuration files.

item.title: CVE-2019-6340 — Drupal Core
item.description: Threat Signal 74. In Drupal Core, some field types do not properly sanitize data from non-form sources. This can lead to arbitrary PHP code execution in some cases.

item.title: CVE-2016-0752 — Rails Ruby on Rails
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Directory traversal vulnerability in Action View in Ruby on Rails allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files.

item.title: CVE-2014-3120 — Elastic Elasticsearch
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Elasticsearch enables dynamic scripting, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary MVEL expressions and Java code.

item.title: CVE-2010-4344 — Exim Exim
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Heap-based buffer overflow in the string_vformat function in string.c in Exim before 4.70 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via an SMTP session.

item.title: CVE-2019-0841 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 74. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppXSVC improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2017-6077 — NETGEAR Wireless Router DGN2200
item.description: Threat Signal 74. NETGEAR DGN2200 wireless routers contain a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-20699 — Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 74. A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2016-1019 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2013-1347 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 74. This vulnerability may corrupt memory in a way that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user within Internet Explorer.

item.title: CVE-2010-3333 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 74. A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the parsing of RTF data in Microsoft Office and earlier allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-8570 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 74. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office software when it fails to properly handle objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2021-21315 — Npm package System Information Library for Node.JS
item.description: Threat Signal 74. In this vulnerability, an attacker can send a malicious payload that will exploit the name parameter. After successful exploitation, attackers can execute remote.

item.title: CVE-2020-14864 — Oracle Intelligence Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Path traversal vulnerability, where an attacker can target the preview FilePath parameter of the getPreviewImage function to get access to arbitrary system file.

item.title: CVE-2020-6418 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-4427 — IBM Data Risk Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 74. IBM Data Risk Manager contains a security bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions when configured with SAML authentication. By sending a specially crafted HTTP request, an attacker could exploit this vulnerability to bypass the authentication process and gain full administrative access to the system.

item.title: CVE-2017-8759 — Microsoft .NET Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft .NET Framework contains a remote code execution vulnerability when processing untrusted input that could allow an attacker to take control of an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2020-0601 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Microsoft Windows CryptoAPI (Crypt32.dll) contains a spoofing vulnerability in the way it validates Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) certificates. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by using a spoofed code-signing certificate to sign a malicious executable, making it appear the file was from a trusted, legitimate source. A successful exploit could also allow the attacker to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks and decrypt confidential information on user connections to the affected software. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of CurveBall.

item.title: CVE-2020-14883 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability in the Console component with high impacts to confidentilaity, integrity, and availability.

item.title: CVE-2019-20085 — TVT NVMS-1000
item.description: Threat Signal 74. TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

item.title: CVE-2020-5849 — Unraid Unraid
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-3199 — ONLYOFFICE Docs
item.description: Threat Signal 73. ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-49105 — ownCloud ownCloud
item.description: Threat Signal 73. ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

item.title: CVE-2019-1068 — Microsoft SQL Server
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

item.title: CVE-2026-15409 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 73. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

item.title: CVE-2026-33634 — Aquasecurity Trivy
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Aquasecurity Trivy contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain access to everything in the CI/CD environment, including all tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, database passwords, and any sensitive configuration in memory.
